AEGIS_BOSS.name: Vaelor, the Aegis Colossus
AEGIS_BOSS.desc: The guardian of the peaks raises an Aegis that absorbs damage. Its beam only fires while the Aegis holds – break it!

naturesHealing.name: Nature's Healing
naturesHealing.desc: Every 5th round, half of all debuffs on heroes and enemies are cleansed.

verdantBloom.name: Verdant Bloom
verdantBloom.desc: All healing is 25% more effective – for heroes and enemies.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.desc: At the start of every fight, one random hero and one random enemy are Overgrown: +25% damage and Block.

bloodMoon.name: Blood Moon
bloodMoon.desc: Enemies heal for 15% of the damage they deal to heroes. Heroes do not heal from it.

restlessDead.name: Restless Dead
restlessDead.desc: In every fight, the first enemy that falls rises again with 30% HP. Heroes do not rise.

witchingHour.name: Witching Hour
witchingHour.desc: Every 4th round, all heroes and enemies deal +2 damage per hit for the rest of the fight.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.desc: At the start of every round, every hero and every enemy gains 3 Block.

rockslide.name: Rockslide
rockslide.desc: Every 3rd round, falling rocks deal 5 damage to every hero and every enemy.

ironVeins.name: Iron Veins
ironVeins.desc: All Block gained is 25% higher – for heroes and enemies.

scorchingSun.name: Scorching Sun
scorchingSun.desc: At the start of every round, every hero and every enemy gains 1 Burn.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.desc: Every attack hit has a 15% chance to miss – for heroes and enemies.

shiftingSands.name: Shifting Sands
shiftingSands.desc: At the start of every round, one random hero and one random enemy become Weak (1 turn).

killer.name: Killer Instinct
killer.buffText: Crit attacks always Crit – against every enemy.

venomedge.name: Venomous Edge
venomedge.buffText: Every hit of your attacks also applies 2 Poison.

music.__fn: function music(name){ A.want = name; if(A.ctx) start(name); }

CLASS_INFO.knight: Heavy armor and big weapons. Tough, protects the team and hits hard.
CLASS_INFO.assassin: Quick and sneaky: cheap cards, lots of card draw, poison and deadly critical hits.
CLASS_INFO.mage: Master of fire, ice and lightning who burns, freezes and shocks enemies from the back row.
CLASS_INFO.ranger: Ranged fighter who marks enemies and chains clever combos into big finishing shots.
CLASS_INFO.brawler: Fist fighter who draws the enemies onto himself, soaks up their hits and hits back hard.
CLASS_INFO.soulbinder: Support who links, strengthens and creates cards for the whole team.
CLASS_INFO.eldritch: Wields the dark powers of the deep: slow and risky at first, terrifyingly strong later.

forge.name: The Forge
forge.desc: The blacksmith is away. His hammer and anvil are free to use – upgrade cards (+25% to all their values, or 1 Energy cheaper for 5-Energy cards) as often as you dare. After the first upgrade there is a 20% chance he comes back, after every further one 20% more… and he will not be happy.

arena.name: The Arena
arena.desc: A crowd roars. Fight for prizes: Easy is a normal fight, Medium an elite, Hard two elites at once.

buddy.name: Build your Buddy
buddy.desc: A strange workbench. Roll a rarity (at least Uncommon), then build your own card: for every rarity step it gets one modification (choose 1 of 2) and one gem slot. Modifications stack.

anomaly.name: The Anomaly
anomaly.desc: A shimmering rift. Throw a card in and it comes back as a different, random card. The first try is free, every further try costs 10 Gold more. Every player transforms cards in their own deck and pays for their own tries – the price rises for each hero separately.

GLOSS_STATUS: Permanent for the whole run (max 100). At 10 / 25 / 50 / 100 the Acolyte's cards get bonuses and his body changes. Costs Sanity every turn.
Loses its next turn. For the Acolyte it happens when his Sanity hits 0 – then Sanity refills.
4+: deals 25% less damage · 7+: takes 25% more damage · 10: Nightmare – Dream consumed, loses 20% of its max HP (bosses 10%), ignoring Block. Reality Distortion cards trigger it already at 9.
Resource for summoning Servants of the Deep. Builds up during the fight.

Links two cards, ideally of different heroes (same color + chain number on both). Playing one makes the other Resonate. Playing a Resonating card: ALL its values +50% (damage, Block, cards drawn, Energy, buffs, debuffs) and the other card's owner draws 1. Links last the whole fight.
A colored mark on a card: Edge (+damage), Ward (+Block), Haste (−cost), Mend (heal) or Echo (plays twice). Same kinds stack. Lasts until the end of the fight (★ = permanent).

Created cards cost 0 and vanish after use. Tailored Gifts fit the specialization that gets them – every spec has its own Gift with its own mechanics. All forged cards are listed under Unique Cards in the Soulforger glossary.
Absorbs incoming attack damage. Heroes lose their Block at the start of each round, enemies at the start of their turn.
Buff cards are played once per fight and last until it ends. Might: attacks deal extra damage per hit.
A card that was already played this turn and is drawn again costs +1 Energy per earlier play – only for this turn. Stops endless loops with tiny decks.
A card with Vanish goes to the Vanished pile when played and comes back next fight. All Buff cards have Vanish.
Gain Block at the start of each of your turns until the end of the fight.
Attacks with Crit deal double damage to the rearmost (right-most) enemy. Enemies in front of it are hit normally.

A Marked enemy takes +1% damage per Mark from every hit – from every hero (40 Marks = +40%). Marks stay until a Detonate effect makes them explode (damage per Mark, also boosted by the +%). If the detonation kills, the Marks jump to another enemy.

Max 10, lasts the whole fight. +1 whenever the Ranger plays a card of a different type than his previous one (Attack → Skill → Block …), more from cards. Finishers and “Spend Momentum” effects use it.
Every card of the Rift Architect has a Rune slot. Runes are made with the card Rune Forge and socketed like gems; they change how the card works.
Whenever you gain Momentum, gain 1 more until the end of the fight.

Only works in the front slot. Until his next turn, single-target enemy attacks hit only the taunting hero; area and splash attacks stay as they are. An enemy that would not attack this round attacks him anyway, in addition to its action, with its weakest attack (or a weak basic hit). If he is moved out of the front slot, the Taunt breaks. Enemies taunt the same way: only the front enemy can taunt.
Each stack: 10% less damage taken (max. 50%). Every hit taken removes 1 stack.
+4 damage per stack on the next hit, then it is used up.
+1 per enemy hit taken. At 5 the Knockout Punch hits the enemy with the most HP (start of turn, or right away through Fury cards).
Stacks from his hits. An ally attack cashes in the whole stack: +1 damage per stack, all heroes get 50% as Block, the Street Fighter gets Payback.
+1 damage per stack on all his hits in his next turn. Finishers spend it for extra damage and heal 50% of it.
Every hit of your attacks also applies Poison until the end of the fight.
Crit attacks always Crit against every enemy, also those in front, until the end of the fight.
Lightning damage ranges always roll their maximum until the end of the fight.
Draw extra cards at the start of each of your turns until the end of the fight.

No damage from enemy attacks until the hero's next turn – but if all teammates are dead, the enemies find you and you take 50% of the damage. The next attack card deals double damage and uses Invisible up.
Deals 50% less attack damage. Wears off by 1 each turn.
Takes 50% more damage from every source – attacks, Poison, Burn and more. Wears off by 1 each turn.
Enemies lose HP equal to their Poison at the END of their turn, heroes at the END of the round. Poison ignores Block. Then it goes down by 1.
Enemies lose HP equal to their Burn at the START of their turn, heroes at the start of their turn. Ignores Block, then goes down by 1.
At 10 stacks (bosses: 20) the enemy is Frozen. An enemy can never be frozen two turns in a row.

When you play it, choose one: Plunder – steals one buff per target (Taunt, Strength → Power, Bulwark → Guard, Intangible → Invisible). Pierce – ignores Block. Focus – if all hits land on the same enemy, every hit Crits.
When you play it, choose one: Absorb – damage that hits Block becomes your own Block. Pass the Hangover – every hit passes 1 stack of your debuffs to the target. Second Wind – heal 1 per hit.
An enemy can lose a turn (Frozen, Corrupted Mind, stuns) only every other round. Right after losing a turn it is immune until it has acted again.
Block gained from cards is reduced by this amount. Lasts for the whole fight.
Attacks deal this much extra damage.
Enemies: you take damage every time you hit them. Heroes: attackers take damage for every hit, until the hero's next turn.
Every enemy hit on this hero gives the attacker Burn. Lasts until the hero's next turn.
Every enemy hit on this hero gives the attacker Ice. Lasts until the hero's next turn.
Every enemy hit on this hero deals random damage back to the attacker. Lasts until the hero's next turn.
For a few enemy turns, all enemies take damage and Ice at the start of the enemy turn.
Heals for all unblocked damage it deals.
A destroyed part grows back after 3 turns unless all parts are destroyed.
Calls minions. They flee when their master falls.
Adds Hex curses to your discard pile. Each Hex in hand at the end of a turn deals 3 damage.
The enemy will apply a negative effect to your heroes.
The enemy will make itself stronger.

SHIFTER_BOSS.name: Morrgan the Shapeshifter
SHIFTER_BOSS.desc: The druid of the raging woods starts as a Wolf. After a number of cards played by your team (more heroes: more cards) he interrupts: your turn ends and he transforms – Bear (Block + heals 15%), Hawk (gains Strength) or Serpent (Poison on all heroes). Each transform is stronger than the last!

soulanvil.name: Soul Anvil
soulanvil.buffText: At the start of each turn, a random ally gets a Tailored Gift.

knight.name: Templar
knight.desc: Shields the whole team, heals and punishes attackers with Thorns. His attacks are weaker but also give Block.
knight.passive: Whenever the Templar plays a non-Attack card, he gains 1 Block and 2 Thorns until his next turn.

knight.name: Barbarian
knight.desc: Huge damage, Weak and Vulnerable. Some cards hurt him for even more damage – Meat Shanks heal him back up.
knight.passive: The first time each turn the Barbarian kills an enemy, he draws 1 card and gains 2 Energy.

knight.name: Gladiator
knight.desc: A balanced fighter with solid attacks and defenses who grows stronger with every fight.
knight.passive: After every won fight, one random card gains +1 damage and another gains +1 Block – permanently.

mage.name: Fire Mage
mage.desc: Masters fire. Lots of Burn, and Flame Armor burns everyone who attacks her.
mage.passive: Every hit from the Fire Mage's attacks also applies 1 Burn.

mage.name: Ice Mage
mage.desc: Freezes enemies in place. Ice Armor chills everyone who attacks her.
mage.passive: Every time the Ice Mage applies Ice, it applies 1 more.

mage.name: Storm Mage
mage.desc: Lightning spells deal a random amount of damage – higher on average. Damage gems widen the range. Static Armor shocks attackers.
mage.passive: In the first 2 turns of every fight the Storm Mage gains 2 extra Energy.

assassin.name: Thief
assassin.desc: Slippery and rich. Two Vanish cards, few other defenses – and he steals Gold from his enemies.
assassin.passive: The Thief deals +1 damage per hit for every 50 Gold he owns.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.desc: Lethal single-target damage. His deck is full of cards that can Crit, and Backstab shines against lone targets. One Vanish for defense.
assassin.passive: When the Assassin kills an enemy, he becomes Invisible.

assassin.name: Deathbringer
assassin.desc: Drowns enemies in Poison and defends with Block cards. Poison keeps spreading.
assassin.passive: When a poisoned enemy dies, its Poison spreads to the nearest enemy.

ranger.name: Deadeye
ranger.desc: Single-target burst. Marks the target, then crits it hard. Crits work like the Assassin's – plus his passive lets him crit heavily Marked enemies anywhere.
ranger.passive:
The Deadeye's Crit attacks also Crit against enemies with 10 or more Marks – not only the rearmost one.
Momentum (all Rangers): +1 whenever you play a different card type than your previous card (Attack → Skill → Block …). Max 10, lasts the whole fight; finishers and “Spend Momentum” effects use it.

ranger.name: Stormweaver
ranger.desc: Multi-hits, procs and combo chains. Long turns create free Spark Arrows that keep the chain going.
ranger.passive:
Every 3rd card the Stormweaver plays in a turn adds a Spark Arrow to his hand (0 Energy, 4 damage, 1 Mark, once).
Momentum (all Rangers): +1 whenever you play a different card type than your previous card (Attack → Skill → Block …). Max 10, lasts the whole fight; finishers and “Spend Momentum” effects use it.

ranger.name: Rift Architect
ranger.desc: Builds custom attacks: every card has a Rune slot next to its gem slots. Runes change how a card works – Marks, Momentum, Echoes, Detonations …
ranger.passive:
All of the Rift Architect's cards have a Rune slot. Runes are made with Rune Forge (in his starting deck).
Momentum (all Rangers): +1 whenever you play a different card type than your previous card (Attack → Skill → Block …). Max 10, lasts the whole fight; finishers and “Spend Momentum” effects use it.

brawler.name: Knockout Champion
brawler.desc: No attack or Block cards: he buffs himself with Power, Combo, Reach and Guard, provokes the enemies – and every 5 hits he takes, he answers with one devastating Knockout Punch. Fragile: 60 Max HP, only 50% Block.
brawler.passive:
Starts with only 60 Max HP and gains only 50% of all Block. Heals 35% of the damage his Knockout Punch deals.
Knockout Punch: every enemy hit he takes gives 1 Fury. At 5 Fury he automatically punches the enemy with the most HP at the start of his turn (Fury cards can trigger it right away) – with enough Fury for two punches, he punches twice. Every hit deals +10% of his Max HP extra, and every punch gives him +1 Max HP. The punch uses the Knockout Punch card – socket gems into it!

brawler.name: Drunk Kung Fu Master
brawler.desc: No Block cards – her attacks are the defense. When playing an attack, she picks a bonus: defensive (Absorb Block, pass on debuffs, heal) or offensive (Plunder, Pierce, Focus).
brawler.passive: All her attacks hit random enemies.

brawler.name: Street Fighter at Night
brawler.desc: Many light multi-hits that mark enemies for his team, plus a few brutal finishers that cash in everything he has earned.
brawler.passive: Every hit puts Deserves a Beating on the target. When an ally attacks it, the whole stack is cashed in: +1 damage per stack, all heroes get 50% of it as Block – and he gets that many Payback stacks: +1 damage on every hit in his next turn. His finishers spend all Payback for big damage and heal him for 50% of the spent stacks.

soulbinder.name: Chainweaver
soulbinder.desc: Soulbinds cards of different heroes. Playing a linked card makes its partner Resonate – all values of the Resonating card rise by 50% (damage, Block, cards, Energy, buffs, debuffs) and its partner's owner draws a card.
soulbinder.passive:
Whenever a Soulbind completes, ALL enemies take 3 damage for every active Soulbind.
Soulbind: play one linked card → its partner Resonates. Play the Resonating card → ALL its values +50% (also cards, Energy, buffs, debuffs) and the other owner draws 1. Links last the whole fight.

soulbinder.name: Runebinder
soulbinder.desc: Etches Imprints onto her allies' cards: Edge (+damage), Ward (+Block), Haste (−cost), Mending (heal) and Echo (plays twice). Imprints of the same kind stack.
soulbinder.passive:
After every won fight, one random attack card in the team's decks permanently gains +2 damage and one random skill or block card permanently gains +2 Block (★).
Imprint: a bonus on a card in a hero's hand. It lasts until the end of the fight.

soulbinder.name: Soulforger
soulbinder.desc: Forges cards for her allies: Soul Sparks, Spirit Wards and Tailored Gifts made for each specialization, using that hero's own mechanics.
soulbinder.passive:
Whenever any hero plays a card she created, she gains 1 Energy (max 3 per round).
Soulcraft: created cards cost 0 and vanish after use.

eldritch.name: Cthulhu's Acolyte
eldritch.desc: Corruption cards make him stronger forever – and turn him step by step into a monster. At 10 / 25 / 50 / 100 Corruption his cards gain bonuses; some Block cards turn into life-stealing attacks. But his Sanity drains faster the more corrupted he is.
eldritch.passive:
+1 damage per hit for every 25 Corruption.
Corruption: permanent for the whole run (max 100). Sanity: each turn he loses 1 Sanity per 10 Corruption. At 0 he gets Corrupted Mind: he loses his turn and ALL his Energy, then Sanity refills. At 100 Corruption, every further Corruption he gains costs 1 Sanity.

eldritch.name: Cthulhu's Dreamweaver
eldritch.desc: Marks enemies with Dream and decides when to cash it in: early for small effects, or wait for a Nightmare. Some cards change with the target's Dream (Reality Distortion).
eldritch.passive:
Whenever ANY hero's attack hits an enemy that has Dream, it gains +1 Dream (once per card).
Dream: 4+ = deals 25% less damage · 7+ = takes 25% more damage · 10 = Nightmare: the Dream is consumed and it loses 20% of its max HP (bosses 10%), ignoring Block.

eldritch.name: Cthulhu's Tidecaller
eldritch.desc: Builds Depth and summons Servants of the Deep that fight for the team. Feed them, fuse them – or sacrifice them for Depth, cards and Block. Starts slow, grows every turn.
eldritch.passive:
Start every fight with 3 Depth. Gain 1 Depth at the start of each of your turns, and 1 Depth whenever an enemy dies.
Servants (max 5) act at the end of your turn and stay until the fight ends: Spawn (2 Depth) · Guardian (4) · Leviathan (8) · The Sleeping One (10).
